artworks.title: Les Hazards heureux de l'Escarpolettes (The Swing)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate garden scene. The image shows a park landscape with lush foliage, statues, and a swing hanging from a tree. Surrounding the swing are various vegetation and flowers. The background features detailed renderings of trees and shrubs, creating a sense of depth in a secluded setting. The use of shading and line work adds texture and depth to the scene, suggesting an atmosphere of elegance and romanticism typical of rococo art.

artworks.title: Les Hazards heureux de l'Escarpolettes (The Swing)
artworks.artist: Nicolas Delaunay after Jean-Honoré Fragonard and Pierre-Philippe Choffard
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a print of a garden scene with three people. In the center is an elegantly dressed woman on a swing. She is facing the right and wearing a flowing gown with a low neckline, a ruffle around her neck, and a plumed hat. She is holding the ropes of the swing and kicking her feet up, and one of her shoes is flying off of her outstretched foot. Behind her on the left, a man is holding long ropes connected to the swing, and on the right a man lays on the ground below the woman. Both men have white hair that curls around their ears, and they wear jackets with white cravats and have black hats near them. Surrounding these three people is a garden with lush, leafy plants and several statues of cherubic figures. Below the print is a line of text and a design that looks like a shield or emblem.

artworks.title: The Waterworks
artworks.description: This is a print of a scene featuring a lavish bed with draped curtains and a large canopy. One woman is laying on the bed, partially covered with fabric, while another woman stands above her, nude. A third partially clothed woman lays on her stomach at the edge of the bed, and a small dog rests underneath the bed. In front of the bed, one floorboard has been removed, and two jets of water erupt out of the floor and on to the women on the bed. In the top left corner, another woman looks down from an alcove at the scene below.

artworks.title: Le pot au lait
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on their stomach within a circular frame. The person has one leg bent and is pouring a jug, which is spilling liquid. The title at the bottom reads "Le Pot Au Lait." A younger person is partially visible on the left, while another individual stands in the background with arms raised. The background features a pastoral landscape with trees and cloud formations. The frame is ornately decorated with floral patterns and classical embellishments.

artworks.title: Le Verre d'eau
artworks.description: The image is an illustration within an oval frame, showing a partial view of two figures and a reclining person. The reclining person is positioned with their back against large pillows, draped in fabric. Their facial features are delicate, with closed eyes and curled hair framing the face. Two figures to the left are dressed in historical garments typical of the 18th century. The background features heavy drapery and elaborate floral and scrollwork details, in a Rococo style.

artworks.title: S'il m'etoit aussi fidele
artworks.artist: Antoine Francois Dennel after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The woman is seated on a finely draped bed, leaning forward with her hands clasped in front. She has long wavy hair, and is looking at a small dog on a stool. She is wearing a loose garment that partially exposes her upper body. Small shoes are on the floor next to the bed, partially obscured. A curtain and architectural column are in the background, framed ornately with decorative patterns.

artworks.title: Dites donc s'il vous plait
artworks.description: This print shows a group of adults and children within a circular frame decorated with ivy-like leaves. In the center is a seated woman in profile, facing the left. She sits on a low bench or step. She has a straight nose, arched eyebrows, and dark hair styled in a loose updo, and she is wearing a flowing gown with a low neckline and puffed sleeves. She appears to hold a large, round object in her right hand and a small knife-like object in her left hand. On the left, a small child stands in front of her. The child is nude except for a loose shirt, and has short, curly hair. Two more people are on the ground behind the child, one that may be a child and one that may be an adult, both wearing dresses and looking towards the child. On the right, behind the seated woman, are two more people, one young child in a dress and one child or adult in a wide-brimmed hat and collared shirt. All of the people have pale skin. The setting includes potted plants and large urns, along with a ledge or window on the right. Some objects are scattered on the ground, including a cluster of what look like turnips on the right, and in the center some long objects and a small round ball.

artworks.title: Le Petit prédicateur
artworks.description: The artwork depicts several individuals shown from head to toe. At the center, a small child is standing on a raised platform or box, reaching toward the left with curly hair. Nearby, a woman is kneeling, looking at the child with another young child seated opposite her. Another woman beside the platform is leaning in, with her hair wrapped and covered. On the far right, a man sits with a child lying on his lap. The figures are in a domestic setting, surrounded by open books, scrolls, and a hat on the floor. The background showcases raised brick patterns and flowing drapery, with a circular garland of leaves framing the composition.

artworks.title: Le Petit prédicateur
artworks.description: The image includes a circular frame with floral decorations and ribbons. Inside the frame, there are figures showing different body parts. On the left, a woman leans over a large trunk, holding a small child. The child, with curly hair, is shown gesturing with one arm raised. On the floor, another child with curly hair reaches towards the standing child. Next to them, an older woman sits, interacting with the children. In the background to the right, a shadowy figure holds a small child. The setting is a simple interior with objects like toys and pieces of cloth scattered around.

artworks.title: Les Baignets
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic gathering scene. The image depicts several figures gathered around a low table laden with food under a wooden roof structure. An individual tends to a pot or pan over a fire, while a dog watches nearby. The backdrop includes a brick or stone wall and a view of trees and foliage through an opening, indicating an outdoor setting. The composition is circular, emphasizing the central gathering and creating a sense of warmth and community.

artworks.title: Les Baignets
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene in a rustic kitchen. The drawing shows a group of people gathered around a hearth inside a round frame. The scene depicts a warm, cozy kitchen environment where food is central. A woman is crouched down as she cooks over the open fire, portrayed in the act of frying, with the flames illuminating the figures and casting soft shadows. A cluster of individuals, including children and adults, appear to be enjoying the moment. One of the children is tugging on a woman's skirt, and there is a dog nearby. The scene is framed by a wreath of fruits and leaves, and below the central imagery, a banner reads "LES BAIGNETS."

artworks.title: L'Education fait tout
artworks.description: The image shows a group of six children arranged in a circle. The central figure, with curly hair tied up, is sitting cross-legged with her back towards the viewer. She is raising her hands as if presenting a mask to a child seated in front of her. Another child is behind, with hands on the shoulder of the seated child. On the right side, two children are seated, one wearing a hat. A small child is resting on the lap of the child with the hat. The setting appears to be an interior space with brick walls, and greenery is draped across a shelf in the background above a pot. The scene is enclosed in an ornate circular frame with a floral motif.

artworks.title: L'Education fait tout
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting several figures seated around a central figure. The scene is set within a circular frame adorned with foliage and floral patterns. The central area shows an interior space with a brick backdrop and leafy decoration near a window. The figures are engaged in a gathering, with one figure gesturing enthusiastically. The clothing and surroundings suggest a historical or rustic setting. The frame's decorative elements enhance the classic and timeless quality of the scene.

artworks.title: L'heureuse fécondité
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a young child, while another child sits beside her. Other people, both adults and children, are present in the scene. A woman with a head covering is looking through a window-like opening on the right. The setting includes architectural elements such as columns and drapery, with a table on the left holding various objects.

artworks.title: L'innocence inspire la tendresse
artworks.artist: Etienne Claude Voysard after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows several figures within a circular frame adorned with floral arrangements. A woman is leaning over a crib, looking affectionately at a baby. Two babies lie in the crib, partly covered with a blanket. Another figure, likely a woman, is seated beside them. The background suggests a rustic interior, possibly a room with simple wooden furnishings. The frame around the image is decorated with floral designs and features a small emblem at the bottom center. The text "L'INNOCENCE INSPIRE LA TENDRESSE" is inscribed below the circular frame.

artworks.title: La Bonne Mère
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in an elaborate dress seated on a bench, holding a teacup and reaching out to a saucer. Her face is turned slightly to the right, displaying delicate features. Her hair is styled with a headpiece or feathers. She wears a flowing gown with puffed sleeves, a corseted bodice, and lace details. Beside her is another figure covered with fabric, facing away. The background features a garden with trees and foliage. Another figure in the background, possibly a servant or youth, is somewhat obscured by greenery, holding a tray.

artworks.title: La Bonne Mère
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated outdoors with two children. She holds a child on her lap while another child stands beside her. The woman has a calm expression and wears a bonnet. She is dressed in a flowing gown. The child on her lap seems to be resting, while the other child pours liquid from a jug. The background is filled with foliage, creating a serene atmosphere. The image is framed in an oval shape.

artworks.title: La famille du fermier
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people engaging in different activities within a historical setting. The scene includes mostly full body depictions of individuals. In the center, a woman is seated, wearing a flowing dress, and holding a baby, while another woman leans over her shoulder to look at the child. Both women have their hair tied back. The baby has curly hair and is being held gently. Another child is seen to the side, also with curly hair, near a pet or livestock animal. To the far right, through a window space, another person, wearing a hat, interacts with a goat which is peering in. The individuals are wearing long, draped garments. In this scene, a child sitting on the floor holds a small animal or object. Around them, textured stone columns, an open window with draped curtains, and rustic furnishings set a classical environment. The floor appears uneven, with cracked tiles and stray objects. A basket hangs on the wall to the right, and various household items can be seen in the background.

artworks.title: La famille du fermier
artworks.artist: Clément-Pierre Marillier and Antoine Louis Romanet after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: The image shows several people in a domestic setting. A woman seated on the floor is holding a child, while another woman beside her leans forward towards the child. Other children are present, some interacting with animals. There is a person outside the window holding a goat, and the room contains a tall column, draped fabric, and a stone-covered floor with straw and a fallen hat. Classic architecture and archways are visible in the background.

artworks.title: La famille du fermier
artworks.artist: Clément-Pierre Marillier and Antoine Louis Romanet after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.description: Multiple people are shown in the image, with a woman seated near the center, cradling a small child on her lap, and another child clinging to her side. Another adult figure leans over the woman's shoulder, only their head and shoulders visible. Several children are present, with one interacting with a donkey's head through a window opening, and another child holding a dog on the floor. The woman appears calm, with styled hair, wearing a loose-fitting dress. The setting is rustic, with textured stone walls, heavy curtains, and a window with an open shutter. Additional elements such as a basket and a small fabric bag contribute to the domestic scene. The lighting in the composition is dim, except for the brightness illuminating the family from the window.

artworks.title: The Little Park (Le petit parc)
artworks.description: The image depicts a garden scene with lush vegetation, architectural elements, and human figures. The horizon appears high, with a wall and architectural features obscured by plants. The intricate etching style uses continuous lines for texture and detail. The monochromatic palette in varying shades of gray creates a serene atmosphere. A lion statue and human figures are visible in a clearing, adding depth. The sky features clouds with subtle hints of light.

artworks.title: The Tax Collectors (Les traitants)
artworks.description: This print shows three people. On the left, there are two standing men, both facing a seated man on the right. The figure on the far left is an older man with pale skin, wearing a long coat, trousers, boots, and what appears to be a dark turban or headwrap. One of his hands is on his belt, and the other is on a large sack-like object that sits on a surface in front of the seated man. Standing next to him, with his hand on the first man's shoulder, is another bearded man with light gray skin and prominent cheekbones, wearing a white cap and leaning slightly forward toward the seated man at the table. The seated individual is an elderly man with pale skin, a beard, and a bald head, dressed in robes, with one hand on the table or surface in front of him and the other raised up. He looks up at the standing men, his mouth in a frown. The background is shadowy, made with thin crosshatched lines.

artworks.title: Marie-Antoinette of France
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait showing the upper body of a woman seated with her upper body turned slightly to her left and her head facing forward. She has a serene expression with delicate, soft facial features and a high forehead. Her hair is styled in an intricate updo adorned with a bow or ribbon and possibly flowers. She is wearing an elaborate gown with a ruffled neckline and sleeves, decorated with vertical bands and what appears to be intricate lacing. A flower is pinned to her left shoulder. Around her neck is a fine choker or necklace. The portrait is set within a large oval frame that is embellished with floral motifs, bows, and a crest featuring a crown at the bottom. The background is a textured canvas or paper that provides a simple backdrop to her image and the elaborate frame around her.
